notes.title: New DLC Course Available: Dream Golf VR - Loopy Backrooms
notes.content:
New DLC Course Available: Loopy Backrooms

Today marks the release of a new course with some fun & challenging new mechanics!  

Portals will teleport your ball to new places, changing the way you set up your strategy.  


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2123880/Dream_Golf_VR__Loopy_Backrooms/]Head on over here to download today![/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900354/66be9b6e5f2e321f7dea568950aaf52bde9a8a73.jpg[/img]


Other Fixes & improvements:

- Improved input compatibility across all devices (Vive, Index, Oculus, WMR). Native input set ups should be more user friendly across all devices and haptic feedback should also be working on all devices. 
- The invisible teleport wall bug on Infinity Towers has been fixed.
- Glow golf graphics have been improved to more vibrantly show your color. (Grotto Course, Island Course, Snow Course)
- Arcade Mode animated arrow speed is now proportional to each instance's power.
- Your virtual fingertips will now work when trying to select the ball or when trying to skip the hole.
- Grotto course holes #10 & #12 now reset the ball after being stuck for 10 seconds in the tunnels.


In other news, today also marks the release of an entirely new experience: "Nightmare Rooms VR"  

If you are looking for a scare, this is for you! (not for kids)


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955260/Nightmare_Rooms_VR/]Nightmare Rooms VR[/url]


Thanks for playing & enjoy!

notes.title: Lost Drawings, New Features, & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Today's update brings new content & improvements.


[u][b]New Content:[/b][/u]

- Lost drawings have been scattered over all courses, can you find them all? [i][b]These will only be visible upon unlocking other secrets in the game (make your way downstairs on the title map)[/b][/i].  Goodluck!

- New overworld song for the grotto course, but playable on all.

- New ending song with the option to disable in the title map club house.


[u][b]New Features & Improvements:[/b][/u]

- A couple secret shortcuts have been added to golf holes to allow a more consistent ace.  These will be rare to stumble upon & more will be added in future updates. 

- An option has been added in the title map club house to enable/disable hand disappearing when not in use.

- Sign now exists explaining arcade mode on the title map.

- A cursed barrel has been added in the lower level of the title map to reset all progress towards unlockables (golf balls, clubs, & art).


[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]

- Snap turn bug has been fixed where it would sometimes leave the camera slightly faded after rotating.

- Lighthouse course club sensitivity disables on holes where power shots are required.

- Several other small miscellaneous bugs have been fixed.



Would have liked to bring you an update sooner but will try harder for the next! 


Thanks for playing & enjoy!

notes.title: Arcade Mode + Egg Hunt
notes.content:
Today's update brings a whole new dimension to the experience with ARCADE MODE! 

Now available for all courses, arcade mode will allow players to challenge themselves with a fresh new way to play mini golf.  New traps, obstacles, penalties and rewards await with this game mode.  Try it out with "glow golf" enabled for a new flair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900354/40de115e170a18383b56e92278f28f2536b878fa.jpg[/img]

In addition to arcade mode, a plethora of new ball colors and styles have been added to the game.  Good luck unlocking these though, as they are carefully hidden throughout all courses.  You must find them to unlock them!  It will feel very much like an egg hunt.  There are 7 to unlock on the Grotto course and 14 to unlock for each DLC course for a total of 49 to find.  (Need not venture deep into the jungle).

Aside from these two content updates, a handful of game improvements have been made.  
- The club height now automatically adjusts to your height when you pick up the club.  It is still adjustable, but should be close to your required length.
- Some more materials have been improved
- Additional optimizations have been made

Thanks for playing, enjoy!

notes.title: New Feature: Easy Mode
notes.content:
Today's update brings a new game feature to all courses: EASY MODE

With this mode turned on, you may find the ball has a tendency to want to go "home".  This mode is to be thought of similarly to practice mode, except that it has its own set of local high scores.  

You will find this lever next to the other game options in the clubhouse for all courses.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900354/f6c9442fd6409881a3eee28ccc443cf9d7f940c7.jpg[/img]

Other updates:
- The game mode levers on the title map now function for the practice hole.
- Additional optimizations have been made for the Jungle course that improve performance & game-play.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hand Update
notes.content:
Hello all,

Quick update today for the hands' visibility.  

For those wanting to play with one controller, simply place the unused one on a flat surface and the hand will disappear when not in use.  The hand now also disappears when a club is picked up, for a more natural feeling of holding a club and not being in the way visually when taking a shot.

As a side note, the in-game resolution options have been removed. Sometime after these were added to the game, SteamVR acquired additional functionality to override resolution per game.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Features & Improvements
notes.content:
Today's update brings a handful of new features and improvements!

New Features:
- [Auto Teleport] Automatically be teleported to the next hole once you sink your putt.
- [Music Volume] There is now a setting for game music volume in the clubhouse on the title map.
- [Golfball Sensitivity] At last! Due to popular demand, there is now an option to change the sensitivity of the ball.  This can be found in the clubhouse on the title map.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900354/0348713c565dfb52be80fe431307f80c4d51e570.jpg[/img]

Improvements:
- Ball color selection improved
- Games now start automatically without needing to smash the barrel first
- Snap Turn is now on by default (easier for non-room-scale players)
- The hole will no longer skip is an unused controller (hand) is on the floor and intersects with the ball.
- A few of the holes on the Grotto course have been tweaked 

Thanks for playing, enjoy!

notes.title: Snap turn + more today, DLC coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Updates are listed below:

- Snap turn in 30 degree increments using the grip buttons (side triggers for Oculus)
- Improved physics
- All time averages for each course
- Miscellaneous minor bug fixes
- Practice ball reset: swing club through sign post to reset practice ball
- Optimized file size: 4gb to 1gb
- Cloud save automatic backup

For those interested in more courses, the first DLC installment is coming in 2 weeks!

Dream Golf VR - Lighthouse Island will be available here:
store.steampowered.com/app/768910/Dream_Golf_VR__Lighthouse_Island/


Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hard Mode, Practice Mode, & Leaderboards
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone! 

Today's update brings new features and content.  Here is a list of the most notable updates:

Hard mode
- Up for a new challenge? This mode contains additional holes you want to avoid.  Sinking the ball in one of these will add a stroke!

Practice mode
- Play any hole as many times as you like!

Local high scores
- Keep track of your best games with these new high score boards.

Steam achievements
- Steam achievements have been added for acing a hole.

Steam Leaderboards
- 3 Leaderboards have been added for the competitive ones out there!

List of bugs that have been fixed:
- Hole #3 is missing the score text
- Hole #5 has a teleport navigation glitch
- Ball won't re-spawn if it lands in one of the small water pools
- Only the right motion controller vibrates when hitting the ball
- Slightly touching the barrel will break it but will not start a new game

If you encounter any bugs, please report them in the discussion forum.  

As always, thanks for playing!
